messages:
alex: quick question — after merging terraform/infra#422 i'm seeing ArgoCD sync fail for the svc-auth rollout. GH Actions -> Atlantis -> ArgoCD flow looks ok but secret refs inside the rendered k8s manifests are empty. anyone seen this pattern?
priya: yup saw similar yesterday. error: \"secret \"svc-auth-token\" not found\" during argocd sync. logs show manifests include:
```
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: svc-auth
spec:
  containers:
  - name: app
    env:
    - name: TOKEN
      valueFrom:
        secretKeyRef:
          name: svc-auth-token
          key: token
```
but atlantis/gha render step produced templates with `secretRef: null` earlier.
jamie: likely two different concerns: 1) secrets being generated by terraform (external provider) and not yet present at time of atlantis apply -> argocd sync, or 2) secrets are created but in another namespace due to helm values/namespace mismatch. which flow is creating the secret? tf or external-secrets?
alex: terraform creates a k8s secret via `kubernetes_manifest` resource (we moved from external-secrets). we expected atlantis apply -> commit -> argocd picks up new manifests, but argocd sync runs before secret exists. timing race?
marco: that matches. GH Actions workflow uses matrix runners and we have the following order: gha -> atlantis plan/apply -> push k8s manifests -> argocd auto-sync. If atlantis applied a resource that relies on a secret created by terraform provider in same apply, argo sees the Deployment first and fails because kubelet requires secret present when creating pods.
priya: logs from argocd: `rpc error: code = Unknown desc = sync failed: resources failed to sync: Pod svc-auth: secrets \"svc-auth-token\" not found` — suggests argocd attempted to create pod before secret. We can mitigate two ways: ensure secret created before app manifests, or make argocd wait (sync waves/hooks).
jamie: options: a) make terraform produce only the secret resource and push that before app charts (separate PR / apply), b) add an ArgoCD pre-sync hook job that ensures secret exists, c) switch to sealed-secrets or ExternalSecrets so apps reference sealed artifact and get materialized by operator before sync, d) set `syncWave` annotations in charts to apply secret resources first.
tina: for (b) we can add a pre-sync Job with annotation `argocd.argoproj.io/hook: PreSync` that checks `kubectl get secret svc-auth-token` and exits non-zero until present. example:
```
apiVersion: batch/v1
kind: Job
metadata:
  name: ensure-secret
  annotations:
    argocd.argoproj.io/hook: PreSync
spec:
  template:
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: wait
        image: bitnami/kubectl:latest
        command: ["/bin/sh","-c","until kubectl get secret svc-auth-token -n $ARGOCD_APP_NAMESPACE; do sleep 2; done"]
      restartPolicy: Never
```
marco: that helps but still brittle. prefer moving secret creation out of the same apply: create secret via terraform in infra repo and have separate atlantis job that applies infra first, then app repo. our GH Actions pipeline can orchestrate: run `terraform apply` (or atlantis) and wait for successful apply before pushing manifests that ArgoCD watches.
alex: practical question — can GH Actions runner / atlantis use OIDC to access KMS so terraform provider can create secret material during apply? we don't want to keep long-lived creds on runners.
priya: yes — GH Actions OIDC -> cloud KMS IAM role is our recommended pattern. example step below (GCP example):
```
- name: Configure OIDC
  uses: google-github-actions/auth@v1
  with:
    workload_identity_provider: projects/123/locations/global/workloadIdentityPools/..../providers/...
    service_account: tf-runner@project.iam.gserviceaccount.com
```
then terraform runs with that SA permissions to create secrets.
jamie: another angle: if terraform creates k8s secret via provider (server side), the secret gets created in cluster but argocd may still try to reconcile app concurrently. add a `wait_for_resources` step after apply: a tiny script that waits for the secret until timeout before completing GH job; ensures git commit that triggers argocd isn't pushed until secret exists.
tina: short snippet we added in infra pipeline:
```
# wait-for-secret.sh
for i in {1..60}; do
  kubectl get secret svc-auth-token -n infra || true
  if kubectl get secret svc-auth-token -n infra &>/dev/null; then
    echo ok && exit 0
  fi
  sleep 2
done
exit 1
```
alex: thanks. i can add that to the gha job before the commit. one more: atlantis apply runs in GH Actions runner ephemeral containers — if terraform uses `helm_release` provider that needs tiller/helm client, we saw values with `lookupSecretRef` become blank. could that be due to kubeconfig/namespace context?
priya: yes, ensure `KUBECONFIG` used by atlantis matches cluster and namespace; also `helm` provider in terraform needs correct `release_namespace`. sometimes the provider uses default namespace and then argocd templates end up with different ns. check `metadata.namespace` in rendered templates.
jamie: final sugg: prefer sealed-secrets or ExternalSecrets for production secrets. they decouple secret materialization from CI ordering. for quick patch, add pre-sync hook + wait script + confirm runner OIDC perms.
deploy-bot: atlantis: apply for plan #422 started by @alex — job id b7f3 — i'm posting updates here. :white_check_mark:
marco: i'll follow up with a small GH workflow change that: 1) runs atlantis apply, 2) runs wait-for-secret.sh, 3) pushes manifests tag to `infra-manifests` repo which argocd watches. will open PR with the gh actions diff.
alex: awesome — thanks all. i'll try the wait script + pre-sync job first and report back. :thumbsup:
